description: BOA\*ε is BOA\* with a multiplicative tolerance `1 + ε` on the second objective. It changes one test only: a path is dropped once `(1 + ε) · f2` reaches the second cost of the last solution. Every returned solution is Pareto-optimal, and for each Pareto-optimal cost `s` some returned solution `r` has `r1 ≤ s1` and `r2 ≤ (1 + ε) · s2`. The crate takes `ε` as an exact fraction `num / den`, so the test uses no floating point, and `ε = 0` gives BOA\* again. Use it when a slightly worse second cost is acceptable and a smaller front, found faster, is worth more.

papers.title: Approximate Bi-Criteria Search by Efficient Representation of Subsets of the Pareto-Optimal Frontier
papers.venue: International Conference on Automated Planning and Scheduling (ICAPS)
